comment: save.c savelev():560-563 clear_level_structures() under release_data(), which restore.c dorecover():831 reaches through restlevelfile() for the hero's level. It calls rect.c init_rect(), so a restored game holds one whole-map free rectangle that savelev() never stores. A gnomish Archeologist in debug mode saves on her first turn; the second segment restores and runs #wizloadlua Pri-fila, whose random des.room() calls draw rn2(rect_cnt) in rect.c rnd_rect(). Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
